summary: For nonpregnant, tuberculin-positive patients under 35 with latent infection and no active disease, 300 mg of oral isoniazid daily is prescribed for 9 months.
source_doc: Latent Infection. In nonpregnant tuberculin-positive patients with latent infection who are younger than 35 years and who have no evidence of active disease, isoniazid, 300 mg orally daily, is given for 9 months. Isoniazid has been used for decades, and it is considered safe in pregnancy (Briggs, 2015; Taylor, 2013).
